freezeMeaning: Written before the new consumption evidence execution; does not supersede or re-open any existing scientific protocol or known result
sourcePolicy: Retained local bytes only, SHA-256 verified; no paid calls or downloads

cliIntegrationFreeze.meaning: Additive engineering CLI integration check frozen before CLI executions; source-fit outcomes were already known and are not a new study
cliIntegrationFreeze.positiveControl: Run all 10 real retained distributions twice through CLI, 256 members each, seed 20261110, compare written member/output hashes and decode written gzip paths
cliIntegrationFreeze.negativeControls: CLI central attempt for each of 10 real distributions and each of 22 curated driver ids, plus native central with no accepted pinned six-region registry; every attempt must reject without artifacts
cliIntegrationFreeze.nativeIntegration: Separate explicit hash-pinned supplied joint-registry sensitivity CLI exercises actual regional member engine in tests; synthetic registry is engineering-only, never accepted source calibration
cliIntegrationFreeze.legacySeparation: Only explicit legacy-diagnostic command accepts unregistered positional parameters; mode flags cannot be ignored or promote legacy parameters

studyDecision: No new fit or acceptance study. Existing complete wind/adoption windows were already evaluated; consume their retained paired uncertainty only. Policy price-times-coverage and nowcast lack a compatible independently dated frozen-window source bundle.

realConsumption.selection: all ten retained entity-by-solar/wind distributions, no winner selection
realConsumption.sampling: uniform complete intercept/slope paired-bootstrap draw per member; never independent marginal draws
realConsumption.report: registry/distribution/output hashes, deterministic replay, draw count, min/max per year; do not publish private source rows or member arrays
realConsumption.centralNegativeControl: Attempt central use for all ten; every attempt must reject, including EU solar point-metric winner
realConsumption.failurePolicy: Fail explicitly on hash mismatch, missing source, invalid window, unknown geography, incomplete registry binding or changed paired draw count
realConsumption.noAcceptanceClaim: 256 consumption members are engineering replay only; neither 10,000-member acceptance nor emissions/climate/convergence validation

legacyCensus.intervention: one source field at a time +10%; co2GrowthRatePpm set to 2.0 to cross its explicit threshold
legacyCensus.meaning: Controlled code-path perturbation, not causal evidence, predictive validation or central eligibility; unchanged unused fields remain explicit

preservation: Hash frozen beta, fleet, EV, storage protocols/results and history protocol before and after; never re-fit, relax windows, suppress failures, or rewrite legacy equations
